generator_parameters.private_motifs: b in {6, 7} strictly private; motif peak placed at b=7 (+0.025)

policy_definitions.gp_ucb: argmax_x m_{t,x} + kappa_t * s_{t,x}, kappa_t = sqrt(2 log(M pi^2 t^2 / (6 delta))) (Srinivas et al. 2012), smallest index on ties
policy_definitions.gp_ts: argmax_x mu_tilde_x, single joint draw mu_tilde ~ N(m_t, Sigma_t) via independent seeded RNG, smallest index on ties
policy_definitions.gp_ei: argmax_x log(s_{t,x} * h((m_{t,x} - max_z m_{t,z}) / s_{t,x}) / c_x), exact underflow-free Mills-ratio log_h, smallest index on ties
policy_definitions.kg: argmax_x log(KG_t(x) / c_x), exact Frazier-Powell-Dayanik (2009) O(M log M) convex upper envelope in log-space
policy_definitions.gp_os: Optimistic Separation on shared posterior intervals with stopping beta: b_t = argmax_a (U_a - L^-_a), sample wider of {p_t, q_t}
policy_definitions.gp_root_info: Global optimistic terminal w* = argmax_z u_z; b_t = argmax_{a ni w*} (u_{w*} - max_{z notin S(a)} u_z); z_box = argmax_{z notin S(b_t)} u_z; sample wider of {w*, z_box}
policy_definitions.cd_joint: Algorithm 1 safeguarded contrast-directed acquisition with conic dual mixture p* in Delta(S(b_t)) and eps/2 safeguard
policy_definitions.cd_joint_no_safeguard: CD-Joint ablation removing the mean_contrast <= eps/2 safeguard
policy_definitions.cd_joint_single_witness: CD-Joint ablation restricting p in Delta(S(b_t)) to a single vertex e_y (retaining the eps/2 safeguard)

stopping_rules.credible_ellipsoid_chi95: Exact conic regret <= eps under beta = sqrt(chi2_{r, 0.95}), r = 63, check schedule: every step t<=50, every 5 (t<=500), every 10 (t<=2000), every 20 (t>2000)
stopping_rules.direct_posterior_risk: Valid anytime union-bound MC: N_MC=4096 fresh draws/check, eta=0.01/(K*j*(j+1)), delta_post=0.04
stopping_rules.anytime_frequentist_ay: Abbasi-Yadkori self-normalized ellipsoid B + sqrt(2(gamma_t + log(1/delta))) on exact d=8 linear feature model
